quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses for independent assessment. Direct ordinary meanings and actual labels govern; symmetric, nontransitive exclusions do not assert unrestricted Japanese substitution.
氏名 guards 名前/名 full-name/name labels, not automatically 姓/氏 surname/clan/suffix or 宛名's addressee/address identity.
締め切り guards 期限 deadline and 終わり/仕舞い closing/end labels. Generic restrictions, calendar dates and every limit are not inherited as synonyms.

締め切る guards 閉める/閉じる/閉まる physical closing and 終える/終わる/しまう/止める/止す ending/stopping acceptance labels. Fastening belts on 締める is distinct; completing one's own application procedure on 済ませる is not automatically closing acceptance.

湿る guards ぬれる/湿気/しっとり/じめじめ/じとじと direct wet/moist/damp labels, and しょんぼり/沈む/がっかり low-spirits meanings. This does not propagate to every exhaustion term or equate all reflective quiet with depression; saturation manner and hot/muggy weather alone do not automatically add edges.
ジャーナリスト guards 記者 journalist/reporter, not every author, publisher or text; 社会科学 guards broad 科学 science, not the contrasting 自然科学 field.
しゃがむ has no curated guard: ordinary crouching is not simply chair-sitting, bowing, jumping or hiding by topic.
蛇口 guards コック's directly taught tap/flow-valve family 2862559:1, not its Dutch cook family or 水道 water supply by shared plumbing topic.
弱点 guards 欠点/欠陥/粗 flaw/defect and 苦手 poor-area/weakness meanings. Weak adjective 弱い is not automatically a noun naming the weak point.
車庫 guards 駐車場, whose actual teaching includes indoor parking garages, and 小屋's general shed label; it is not every warehouse, station or repair business.
車掌 has no curated guard; drivers and musical conductors are different roles.
写生 guards 描く/写す depicting/copying and 絵/絵画 drawing/painting labels. 図's diagram/figure is assessed directly, not inherited through 絵; explanation and a depicted object are not automatic equivalents.
社説 guards 記事 article, not every academic paper, opinion itself or editor person. しゃっくり has no curated guard: cough and sneeze are different actions.
シャッター guards 雨戸 shutter and 戸/ドア door labels in physical closure. Not every curtain or blind is a shutter.
しゃぶる guards 吸う sucking and ぺろぺろ/ぺろり licking; raw chew does not automatically make 噛む a synonym.
車輪 guards 車's explicitly taught broader wheel and 輪's ordinary 1555710:3 wheel sense even though its own article emphasizes other selected indices. Wheel is not the entire tire or every circle.
洒落 guards 冗談 joke, ユーモア humor/remark and おしゃれ's direct additional style sense; type/style category alone does not propagate to every スタイル/タイプ/流行 answer.
じゃんけん guards ゲーム/遊び broad game/play labels; this does not identify every sport, contest or leisure activity with rock-paper-scissors.

集会 guards 会/会合/会議/集まり/大会/打ち合わせ/学会/集まる/パーティー overlapping meeting/gathering/event labels, with qualifications retained. Event, legislative institution, crowd/group and meeting hall are not made a transitive clique.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles, no reuse, cover source rows N2:702-N2:721. Named community list, not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Four primary reciprocal N2 pairs: 湿/湿る, 弱/弱点, 庫/車庫, 輪/車輪, bringing the distinct new-article audit total to 164. No new kanji/stroke cards.
Missing primary 氏/締/蛇/掌/洒 remain in metadata and plain text. Kana-primary words keep empty kanji arrays despite recognized rare spellings.
Raw source fields remain separate. 締切 is normalized to explicit same-family 締め切り; additional senses do not independently receive N2 status.

Only the explicitly listed complete comparison bodies were read in full. All captured complete families and all twenty public containers were inspected; dictionary recognition is not measured collocation frequency.
No executed app draws, exhaustive baseline linguistic rereview, measured learning outcomes or native-speaker certification. Blind derivative removes only quizGuardRationale.

actualEntryInspections.location: 動ラ下一; sense 2
actualEntryInspections.observation: The verb's second public sense describes something tasteful/refined and gives an attributive shop example. This supports the related 洒落た店 construction.
actualEntryInspections.limits: A paraphrased tool-observation receipt, not a stored response-byte hash or independent frequency measurement. Public sense 2 is not JMdict1568670:2, which is joking; JMdict's first verb sense concerns stylish dress.

adjudication: GPT36-01: link the existing 姓 article at its substantive introduction in 氏名; this is a minor navigation omission, not an incorrect surname/full-name distinction.

B36-01: add 集会/デモ for the protest-rally overlap in the actual labels/articles, supported by1084000:1 and1084080:1. Explain that 集会 need not be a protest and デモ also names product demonstrations. Do not group every gathering or institution.

B36-02: name the separate ichidan verb 洒落る and explain that its た-form modifies 店; おしゃれ takes な. The reviewer's claim that the verb was absent from the packet was incorrect: complete1568670 was already in the original comparison evidence and its recapture is identical. The article's missing explanation remains a useful finding. Actual public verb sense2 additionally supports the refined-shop use. No new principal mapping or independently assigned N2 verb sense.

Optional notice wording adopted: closed acceptance can also refer to a deadline; do not force every raw Closed gloss into the physical sense. Source-note qualifications already allow this; no TSV or source mapping change.

Optional weak guard removed: 止す's actual label stop doing; give up and its activity/cancellation teaching do not by themselves establish a direct alternative to closing an opening or cutting off acceptance. Shared generic stopping language is insufficient.
Optional translation polish adopted: This is not a joke is a transparent rendering; the original This is no joke was not proved incorrect.

Noun/verb 締め切り/締め切る remains unguarded: deadline; closing versus close up; close applications preserves a meaningful category distinction; the shared stem and co-draw tendency alone are not a direct-meaning argument.

No added 出会い/議会/群れ edges: encounter, legislative institution and crowd/group are not automatically the shared-purpose event. Existing 水道 back-link is optional outside these new-card and N2-kanji requirements.
correctionEvidence.limits: Five new-card corrections only; fifteen new articles, four related kanji edits, all twenty source identities/indices and every baseline word remain unchanged. Original inspection volumes describe the initial capture; supplemental counts are separate. Confirmation remains pending.
